title: A closed internal work order is not listed but counts on the vehicle list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer, with one asset, asset 1.
  • Have a portal contact for this test for customer A, whose portal login and email the tester can use.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed today, on asset 1.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in to the customer portal as customer A's contact.
  2. Open the portal's invoices.
  3. Open the portal's vehicle list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The portal opens.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1's document is not listed.
  • The invoices list's Status filter has no "Closed" value.

Step 3:

  • Asset 1 shows today as Last Service and work order 1 counted under Completed, with $0.00 owed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order), story SV-12296 (Story 12 (portal), The no-charge line in the customer portal)

  • S3-R4: “No payment is recorded (not even the $0 payment a $0 invoice writes today) and no "Invoice paid" log entry is written, no customer transaction or receivable is created, no customer portal notification, email or invoice webhook is sent (the work order status webhook of Story 11 is), no invoice is sent to QuickBooks, the internal invoice is never listed in the Open API invoice lists and invoice.created and invoice.paid are never sent for it (both from the core release on, before Story 11), no tax, fee or discount is added, the shop supplies amount is not charged to the customer (it posts as an expense, Story 10), and the customer portal does not list the document (the portal vehicle list still counts a closed internal or no-charge work order for Last Service and Completed, as a service on the unit with $0.00 owed). Close and Reopen are recorded in the work order log as invoice created and reversed are today.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions (Action | Needs | Without it): “Customer portal | Not applicable | Never shows the document or the work order as an invoice (S3-R4)”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026
